title: driver-mongodb: a master_detail field gets no index, while lookup and user fields do, so a detail read by parent scans the collection (follow-up of #31882)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQXLfvyB5R53VDm3Ka

Filing gate: ④ coordination node: an out-of-scope finding of #31882's step 0 (`/mnt/project-files/server-seat3/31882-step0.md`, main `a15b544d`; seat answer 6738355121). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: the same as #31882 (cloud#4092). A `controlled_by_parent` detail is read by its parent on every permission-filtered read. On MongoDB, that read has no index to use when the parent is a `master_detail` field.
Reader: the `domain:server` seat.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `mongodb master_detail index` → #31882 (driver-sql only), not on point.
class: c · type: Bug
Refs #31882

## 维护者速读

MongoDB 驱动会给查找和用户字段建索引，却漏了主从字段。子对象按父记录读时会扫描整个集合。这张卡补上，做法和 #31882 的 SQL 驱动一致。

## What to build

- In driver-mongodb's schema index derivation, treat a single-valued `master_detail` field the way `lookup` (with a reference) and `user` already are: one implicit non-unique index on the field. Skip multi-valued fields, and do not duplicate an author's declared index that leads with the field.
- An existing deployment gains the index on its next schema sync, and a second sync does nothing.
- Pins: a detail read by parent uses the index (`explain`); the declared indexes are unchanged (CONTROL).
- Clause-②: no. Metadata-protocol: none.
